我们现在准备开始这项史诗工程，环绕[From.From.GetName]星系的恒星来建造未来环形世界的初始框架。

这个框架所需的资源与矿物是史无前例的，我们成百上千最优秀的工程师准备好开始拆解恒星系内的行星，将这些物质用于环形世界建造。
texts.en:
We are now ready to begin the colossal task of building the initial frame of our future Ring World around the primary star of the [From.From.GetName] system.

The amount of resources and materials required to build this skeletal frame will be immense, and hundreds of thousands of our finest engineers stand ready to begin the process of dismantling the system's planetary bodies into matter which can be used in its construction.
